{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute treatment response as change from baseline to final
# Only use patients with valid baseline and final measurements
# We already filtered out baseline = -999.0, so all remaining have valid baseline
# All have valid final (no sentinel values)
df_clean['response_delta'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Group by sex and compute mean response delta
response_by_sex = df_clean.groupby('sex', as_index=False)['response_delta'].mean()

# Compute difference: female - male
female_avg = response_by_sex.loc[response_by_sex['sex'] == 'F', 'response_delta'].iloc[0]
male_avg = response_by_sex.loc[response_by_sex['sex'] == 'M', 'response_delta'].iloc[0]
difference = female_avg - male_avg

# Output results
print("Mean response delta by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)
print(f"\nDifference (female - male): {difference:.4f} ng/mL")"}
